title: Platform Sutra 1, 行由品: a woodcutter hears one line and walks thirty days
desc: The sixth patriarch could not read. He heard one line of the Diamond Sutra in a shop, walked a month to Huangmei, and answered an insult by separating body from nature. Two verses, and the difference between wiping a mirror and having no stand.

title: Platform Sutra 2, 般若品: 摩诃 does not mean "big"
desc: Mahā is defined by subtraction: no edges, no colour, no size. Reciting without the mind moving is like dew and lightning. And 无念 is not the absence of thought — suppressing thought is called a view on the edge.

title: Platform Sutra 3, 疑问品: ten myriad eight thousand li is a diagnosis, not a distance
desc: The Pure Land is relocated, not denied: 十万八千 is ten evils and eight wrong views. The body becomes a city with six gates, and 在家亦得 — with an arithmetic that stays behavioural.

title: Platform Sutra 4, 定慧品: a lamp and its light, and why calm cannot be stockpiled
desc: 定 is the substance of 慧; you cannot buy stillness now and spend it on insight later. 无住 defined as the seam between thoughts, and the warning that follows 无念: cutting off thought is death, not freedom.

title: Platform Sutra 5, 坐禅品: sitting is not sitting
desc: Three ways of sitting wrong: watching the mind (a phantom watching a phantom), watching purity (manufacturing the mark you want to be rid of), and holding the body still while the mouth ranks everyone.

title: Platform Sutra 6, 忏悔品: repentance without a ceremony
desc: Five incenses defined as states and kindled inwardly. 忏 is the past, 悔 is the future — and most people do only the first, which is why the account keeps reopening.

title: Platform Sutra 7, 机缘品: the nun who asked about a character
desc: 字即不识，义即请问: meaning is not stored in the glyph. Fada bows without touching the ground; and reading 开示悟入 as someone else's property is called slandering the sutra.

title: Platform Sutra 8, 顿渐品: sudden and gradual describe people, not the dharma
desc: 法无顿渐，人有利钝 — the whole Northern-Southern quarrel is a classification error about oneself. 住心观静 is called an illness; two versions of 戒定慧, one sequenced, one from a single ground.

title: Platform Sutra 9, 护法品: a lamp lighting a hundred thousand lamps, and why he refuses it
desc: A court summons, declined. 一灯然百千灯 is a chain, and a chain is still 相待. Wisdom breaking affliction installs a subject and an object — the two vehicles' liberation is real and finite.

title: Platform Sutra 10, 付嘱品: thirty-six pairs, of which the Dunhuang text lists thirty-three
desc: The teaching kit: three categories, 出语尽双, and a list that miscounts itself — kept as transmitted, not patched. 动上有不动, and the last verse: 兀兀不修善，腾腾不造恶.
